definitions.explanation: Indicates something that happens regularly every morning.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}コーヒーを{飲|の}みます。
{毎朝|まいあさ}{六時|ろくじ}に{起|お}きます。
examples.english: I wake up at six o'clock every morning.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{散歩|さんぽ}をしています。
examples.english: I take a walk every morning.

notes: {毎朝|まいあさ} is part of the {毎|まい} (every) series: {毎日|まいにち} (every day), {毎週|まいしゅう} (every week), {毎月|まいつき} (every month), {毎年|まいとし/まいねん} (every year). These words typically don't require a particle when used as adverbs.
